\section[(dialogue)]{School, nature, animals and describing words — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R89-first-pass-school-nature-animals-and-describing-wor}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a matter; talk and a language.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a game, a letter, a tree, a leaf, a hill
  \item a forest, a river, a stone, sand, a field
  \item a star, the sun, the moon, the sea, fire
  \item the sky, a dog, a cat, a cow, a buffalo
  \item a goat, a sheep, a sparrow, a lion, an elephant
  \item a monkey, a snake, a peacock, big, small
  \item new, old, good, bad, long
  \item hot, cold, fast, easy, difficult
  \item low, empty, poor, dirty, fat
  \item thin, heavy, true, green, yellow
  \item red, blue, black, brown, sweet
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A game? (\textbf{\mw{खेल}}, \emph{khel}.) A letter? (\textbf{\mw{चिट्ठी}}, \emph{chiṭṭhī}.) A tree? (\textbf{\mw{रूंख}}, \emph{rū̃kh}.) A leaf? (\textbf{\mw{पत्तो}}, \emph{patto}.) A hill? (\textbf{\mw{डूंगर}}, \emph{ḍū̃gar}.) A forest? (\textbf{\mw{जंगळ}}, \emph{jaṅgaḷ}.) A river? (\textbf{\mw{नदी}}, \emph{nadī}.) A stone? (\textbf{\mw{भाटो}}, \emph{bhāṭo}.) Sand? (\textbf{\mw{रेत}}, \emph{ret}.) A field? (\textbf{\mw{खेत}}, \emph{khet}.) A star? (\textbf{\mw{तारो}}, \emph{tāro}.) The sun? (\textbf{\mw{सूरज}}, \emph{sūraj}.) The moon? (\textbf{\mw{चांद}}, \emph{chā̃d}.) The sea? (\textbf{\mw{समंदर}}, \emph{samandar}.) Fire? (\textbf{\mw{आग}}, \emph{āg}.) The sky? (\textbf{\mw{आभो}}, \emph{ābho}.) A dog? (\textbf{\mw{कुत्तो}}, \emph{kutto}.) A cat? (\textbf{\mw{बिल्ली}}, \emph{billī}.) A cow? (\textbf{\mw{गाय}}, \emph{gāy}.) A buffalo? (\textbf{\mw{भैंस}}, \emph{bhaĩs}.) A goat? (\textbf{\mw{बकरी}}, \emph{bakrī}.) A sheep? (\textbf{\mw{भेड़}}, \emph{bheṛ}.) A sparrow? (\textbf{\mw{चिड़ी}}, \emph{chiṛī}.) A lion? (\textbf{\mw{नाहर}}, \emph{nāhar}.) An elephant? (\textbf{\mw{हाथी}}, \emph{hāthī}.) A monkey? (\textbf{\mw{बांदरो}}, \emph{bā̃dro}.) A snake? (\textbf{\mw{सांप}}, \emph{sā̃p}.) A peacock? (\textbf{\mw{मोर}}, \emph{mor}.) Big? (\textbf{\mw{बड़ो}}, \emph{baṛo}.) Small? (\textbf{\mw{छोटो}}, \emph{chhoṭo}.) New? (\textbf{\mw{नुवो}}, \emph{nuvo}.) Old? (\textbf{\mw{जूनो}}, \emph{jūno}.) Good? (\textbf{\mw{आछो}}, \emph{āchho}.) Bad? (\textbf{\mw{माड़ो}}, \emph{māṛo}.) Long? (\textbf{\mw{लांबो}}, \emph{lā̃bo}.) Hot? (\textbf{\mw{गरम}}, \emph{garam}.) Cold? (\textbf{\mw{ठंडो}}, \emph{ṭhaṇḍo}.) Fast? (\textbf{\mw{तेज}}, \emph{tej}.) Easy? (\textbf{\mw{सोरो}}, \emph{soro}.) Difficult? (\textbf{\mw{दोरो}}, \emph{doro}.) Low? (\textbf{\mw{नीचो}}, \emph{nīcho}.) Empty? (\textbf{\mw{खाली}}, \emph{khālī}.) Poor? (\textbf{\mw{गरीब}}, \emph{garīb}.) Dirty? (\textbf{\mw{मैलो}}, \emph{mailo}.) Fat? (\textbf{\mw{मोटो}}, \emph{moṭo}.) Thin? (\textbf{\mw{पतळो}}, \emph{patḷo}.) Heavy? (\textbf{\mw{भारी}}, \emph{bhārī}.) True? (\textbf{\mw{साचो}}, \emph{sācho}.) Green? (\textbf{\mw{हरो}}, \emph{haro}.) Yellow? (\textbf{\mw{पीळो}}, \emph{pīḷo}.) Red? (\textbf{\mw{लाल}}, \emph{lāl}.) Blue? (\textbf{\mw{नीलो}}, \emph{nīlo}.) Black? (\textbf{\mw{काळो}}, \emph{kāḷo}.) Brown? (\textbf{\mw{भूरो}}, \emph{bhūro}.) Sweet? (\textbf{\mw{मीठो}}, \emph{mīṭho}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Time, places, the town, clothes and numbers — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MW-R89-second-pass-time-places-the-town-clothes-and-numbers}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a day and night.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a day, night, morning, a month, a year
  \item an hour, a minute, today, yesterday; tomorrow, now
  \item always, sometimes, quickly, a delay; late, before
  \item far, near, inside, outside, below
  \item here, there, a road, a lane, a station
  \item a bridge, a hotel, the police, a boat, a bicycle
  \item a village, a city, a kurta, pyjama trousers, a shoe
  \item a sock, a pocket, a ring, a watch, a cap
  \item thirty, forty, fifty, sixty, seventy
  \item eighty, ninety, a thousand, a hundred thousand, the world
  \item a colour, a song, a journey, a holiday, love
  \item music, news, a country, a matter; talk, a language
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A day? (\textbf{\mw{दिन}}, \emph{din}.) Night? (\textbf{\mw{रात}}, \emph{rāt}.) Morning? (\textbf{\mw{सवेरो}}, \emph{savero}.) A month? (\textbf{\mw{महीनो}}, \emph{mahīno}.) A year? (\textbf{\mw{बरस}}, \emph{baras}.) An hour? (\textbf{\mw{घंटो}}, \emph{ghaṇṭo}.) A minute? (\textbf{\mw{मिनट}}, \emph{minaṭ}.) Today? (\textbf{\mw{आज}}, \emph{āj}.) Yesterday; tomorrow? (\textbf{\mw{काल}}, \emph{kāl}.) Now? (\textbf{\mw{अबार}}, \emph{abār}.) Always? (\textbf{\mw{हमेसा}}, \emph{hamesā}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\mw{कदी}}, \emph{kadī}.) Quickly? (\textbf{\mw{जल्दी}}, \emph{jaldī}.) A delay; late? (\textbf{\mw{देर}}, \emph{der}.) Before? (\textbf{\mw{पैलां}}, \emph{pailā̃}.) Far? (\textbf{\mw{दूर}}, \emph{dūr}.) Near? (\textbf{\mw{नजीक}}, \emph{najīk}.) Inside? (\textbf{\mw{मांय}}, \emph{mā̃y}.) Outside? (\textbf{\mw{बारै}}, \emph{bārai}.) Below? (\textbf{\mw{नीचे}}, \emph{nīche}.) Here? (\textbf{\mw{अठै}}, \emph{aṭhai}.) There? (\textbf{\mw{बठै}}, \emph{baṭhai}.) A road? (\textbf{\mw{सड़क}}, \emph{saṛak}.) A lane? (\textbf{\mw{गळी}}, \emph{gaḷī}.) A station? (\textbf{\mw{टेसण}}, \emph{ṭesaṇ}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\mw{पुल}}, \emph{pul}.) A hotel? (\textbf{\mw{होटल}}, \emph{hoṭal}.) The police? (\textbf{\mw{पुलिस}}, \emph{pulis}.) A boat? (\textbf{\mw{नाव}}, \emph{nāv}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\mw{साइकल}}, \emph{sāikal}.) A village? (\textbf{\mw{गांव}}, \emph{gā̃v}.) A city? (\textbf{\mw{सहर}}, \emph{sahar}.) A kurta? (\textbf{\mw{कुरतो}}, \emph{kurto}.) Pyjama trousers? (\textbf{\mw{पजामो}}, \emph{pajāmo}.) A shoe? (\textbf{\mw{जूती}}, \emph{jūtī}.) A sock? (\textbf{\mw{मोजो}}, \emph{mojo}.) A pocket? (\textbf{\mw{जेब}}, \emph{jeb}.) A ring? (\textbf{\mw{अंगूठी}}, \emph{aṅgūṭhī}.) A watch? (\textbf{\mw{घड़ी}}, \emph{ghaṛī}.) A cap? (\textbf{\mw{टोपी}}, \emph{ṭopī}.) Thirty? (\textbf{\mw{तीस}}, \emph{tīs}.) Forty? (\textbf{\mw{चाळीस}}, \emph{chāḷīs}.) Fifty? (\textbf{\mw{पचास}}, \emph{pachās}.) Sixty? (\textbf{\mw{साठ}}, \emph{sāṭh}.) Seventy? (\textbf{\mw{सित्तर}}, \emph{sittar}.) Eighty? (\textbf{\mw{अस्सी}}, \emph{assī}.) Ninety? (\textbf{\mw{नब्बै}}, \emph{nabbai}.) A thousand? (\textbf{\mw{हजार}}, \emph{hajār}.) A hundred thousand? (\textbf{\mw{लाख}}, \emph{lākh}.) The world? (\textbf{\mw{दुनिया}}, \emph{duniyā}.) A colour? (\textbf{\mw{रंग}}, \emph{raṅg}.) A song? (\textbf{\mw{गीत}}, \emph{gīt}.) A journey? (\textbf{\mw{जातरा}}, \emph{jātrā}.) A holiday? (\textbf{\mw{छुट्टी}}, \emph{chhuṭṭī}.) Love? (\textbf{\mw{प्रेम}}, \emph{prem}.) Music? (\textbf{\mw{संगीत}}, \emph{saṅgīt}.) News? (\textbf{\mw{खबर}}, \emph{khabar}.) A country? (\textbf{\mw{देस}}, \emph{des}.) A matter; talk? (\textbf{\mw{बात}}, \emph{bāt}.) A language? (\textbf{\mw{भासा}}, \emph{bhāsā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
